findings.text: Provides management of logical port IO ranges keyed by firmware identity, assigning a logical base on registration and withdrawing a range on request.

Registration requires a firmware identity and nonzero extent, requires an operation table for the indirect flavour, rejects duplicate identities and overlapping CPU mapped extents, enforces upper bounds with a fallback shrink for oversize CPU mapped requests, and reports distinct failures for invalid input, duplication, overlap and exhaustion.
Mutation of the global range collection is serialized by one mutex, while lookup and translation use read side protection with deferred reclamation after removal.

Offers translation among hardware extents, CPU addresses and logical tokens, returning an all ones sentinel and emitting a diagnostic when the covering range is missing or unsuitable or the resource does not fit.

Defines families of narrow and wide input, output and bulk transfer operations that select a direct path for low tokens, an indirect operation table path for middle tokens, and no effect or sentinel result outside supported tokens.

Indirect access requires a registered entry covering the token; absence produces a one time warning with sentinel or dropped operation, while direct bulk transfers use a fixed base plus token addressing.
Range descriptor as observed carries firmware identity, hardware base, logical base, extent size, flavour flags, indirect operation table with host context, and list linkage.
Supplies creation, destruction and reinitialization of a fixed capacity LRU cache whose backing objects come from a caller slab cache and whose hash table size equals element count.

Cache element as observed carries an index, current and pending numbers, reference count, LRU linkage and hash linkage; cache as observed carries name, sizing, counters, flags, four list heads, element vector and hash slots.

Elements circulate among free, evictable, in use and pending commit populations with reference counting controlling residency and a commit step promoting pending numbers to current numbers and clearing pending count.
Mutations assert exclusive access through a paranoia flag acquired on entry and released on exit, with a separate nonblocking attempt that retries only while that flag is held.

Lookup hashes by number modulo capacity on the pending number, optionally hiding uncommitted entries; acquisition honours starving, locked and dirty indications plus limits on pending changes and availability of free or evictable victims.
Exposes strict, cumulative and non creating acquisition flavours, plus release, deletion, indexed access, usage test and diagnostic rendering of statistics and per element state.

Misuse such as null cache, zero capacity, out of range index, index mismatch, deletion of a referenced element, release of an unreferenced element or inconsistent pending state triggers abort checks, while undersized backing objects, oversize counts and allocation shortfalls yield null creation.
Implements unsigned 64 bit logical right shift as a half based operation with zero fill, preserving value for zero shift and clearing the high half for shifts at or beyond half width.
Provides single and bulk removal from a two part lightweight queue preserving FIFO order by reversing the newly arrived segment and appending it after previously ready items.
Queue removal is guarded by a spin lock with an early empty test outside the lock and a transient non empty marker while transferring newly arrived items to the ready chain.
Self test record couples queue linkage with an identity integer and a visit counter.
Includes an internal exercise that concurrently circulates records through workers and then validates single removal, bulk removal, conditional filtering with requeue, and final drain.
Enode and root markers: root node tag equals 0x02, type shift equals 0x03, null mark equals 0x04, root parent equals 1, preallocation marker equals 1.
Formatting and tracing selectors provide two pointer rendering variants and a tracepoint string derived from the current function, with tracepoint creation enabled.

Per node type tables define maximum key, slot count, pivot count and minimum occupancy, including a dense slot count reference, fixed wide slot geometries, a triple sized copy type, and half capacity minima with small downward adjustments.
Reserved entry test combines a numeric upper bound with an internal pointer predicate; enode full versus null state is represented by clearing or setting the null mark bit and tested by masking.
Exposes helpers to mark an enode full or not full and to query null presence, plus a cast helper for encoded node pointers and a slab cache pointer for node allocation.
